title: Swarm Cloned Git / Pipeline
description:
Darwin's live execution plan — the single ordered artifact the Primary AI renders, sequences and executes against.

Four concurrent threads of work, each with its own epic: finishing the transition that put every database read and write behind one gateway; rebuilding the swarm substrate on mirrors and private clones so a session is disposable; making a multi-requirement plan a first-class artifact instead of prose in a chat scroll; and unifying the Primary AI and its workers onto the shared agent harness.

They share a plan rather than four plans because they contend for the same things — the same repos, the same machines, the same person's attention — and the contention is the part worth seeing.

title: FP Pipeline - Agent Harness
description: The plan for rebuilding the orchestration layer on first principles, together with the harness adoption that feeds it. It is kept apart from the plan it will eventually supersede because the work here changes how plans are executed: sequencing it inside the plan being rewritten would leave an orchestrator polling a graph its own requirements are in the middle of replacing, and the two eras have to be able to run side by side before either is removed.

title: Phase 3
description: Orchestrator stability work, held out of the FP Pipeline so it is sequenced on its own terms rather than behind that programme.
